body.message:
Thanks for reaching out, Maxime!, week of 25 May works for us. What day and time suits you best? We're available any day between 9am and 6pm.

For the 8, 9 month stay, just so you know, we confirm rates in 3-month blocks, so the first 3 months are locked in at the current rate, with subsequent periods reviewed based on market conditions at the time.
